exclusion_reason: The public issue and compatibility tracker is implemented: a bare report is rejected, a report carrying environment, revision, and a reproduction hash is accepted and maps to a tracker entry, and triage latency is measured against the published freshness level. The benchmark stays red because reproducing the tracked compatibility claim needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the templates reject a bare report and the triage-freshness level is published and measured.
expected_failing_assertion: No tracker template exists to enforce.
active_gate_evidence: test/governance.test.mjs asserts a bare report is rejected, a complete report is accepted and triaged within the published freshness window.
procedure: Submit a bare report and assert rejection.
Submit a report with environment, revision, and repro hash and assert acceptance.
Measure triage freshness against the published level.
pass_criterion: Complete report is accepted and triaged within the level.
